# Kimchi

Napa cabbage kimchi, made in the big 3 litre jar.

## Brine

Salt the quartered cabbage at about 2 percent of its weight and leave it for 6 hours, turning every hour. Rinse three times and squeeze dry.

## Paste

Garlic, ginger, fish sauce, spring onion and gochugaru. The gochugaru comes from Lotus Market on Dock Road, because the co-op doesn't stock it.

## Fermenting

Pack it down hard so the liquid covers the cabbage. Leave it at room temperature for 5 days and burp the jar daily, then move it to the fridge. It keeps for about two months and gets more sour each week.
